notes: Rates checked 2026-11-22 PT. Jubian peak charges matched test-account debits. Bailian prices are published rates.

Streaming measured 2026-11-22 PT from an isolated test host directly to suppliers with short text, thinking off, 64 output tokens maximum and no retries. P95 is the observed maximum. Use these timings for the sampled short requests.

Quality uses five paired synthetic Chinese Muse tasks with thinking off and up to 1024 output tokens. Predeclared checks contribute 80 points and one blinded editorial review contributes 20. Use the case scores as pilot evidence.
In a separate thinking-on continuity audit, 0/3 produced an answer at 1536 output tokens. At 4096, 0/2 produced an answer (one exhausted the cap and one timed out).
The added Jubian candidates use historical tool or stream receipts and account-sample rates. The short-request latency and screenplay pilot above apply to the DeepSeek routes.

muse-cloud-deepseek-flash-auto/deepseek-.finding: In this pilot Flash tied for scoped rewriting and scored higher on continuity audit, source fidelity and the episode hook. The gateway selects Flash suppliers. Consider both routes for budget and timing.

muse-cloud-jubian-pro/deepseek-v4-pro.finding: In this pilot Pro was strongest for continuation between locked episodes (95 vs Flash 75/70). Prefer it when a draft must reconcile multiple fixed episodes and pass a precise state forward.

muse-cloud-jubian-tested/claude-haiku-5-.guidance: Best suited to bounded text classification, structured extraction and short summaries.
muse-cloud-jubian-tested/claude-haiku-5-.verification: Jubian text tool call and subsequent answer passed on November 20; November 22 account sample recorded successful streams with this request model. The tool probe did not record the returned model identifier. This route uses supplier-default thinking. Comparative screenplay scores are pending.
